selected_news.title: Avrupa, Irak‑Türkiye Gelişim Yolunun Bitişini Soruyor
selected_news.summary: Turkey highlight urgent European demand for Development Road at Baghdad Transport Expo IraqiNews
selected_news.source_headline: Turkey highlight urgent European demand for Development Road at Baghdad Transport Expo
selected_news.article_text: Baghdad (IraqiNews.com) – Iraqi Minister of Transport Wahab Salman Al-Hasani announced on Wednesday, November 25, 2026, that Iraq is reclaiming its economic role as a vital transit bridge between East and West through an integrated infrastructure vision linking seaports, airports, railways, and highways, while Turkish Minister of Transport and Infrastructure Abdulkadir Uraloğlu revealed that European officials inquire daily with mounting urgency about the completion timeline for the Iraq-Turkey Development Road project Speaking during the opening of the Iraq International Exhibition and Conference for Transport, Airports, and Logistics at the Baghdad International Fairground Al-Hasani stated that the Ministry of Transport is modernizing its operational systems to convert Iraq’s strategic geography into an engine of economic strength He highlighted major milestones in southern Iraq, noting that core components of the Grand Faw Port are nearing completion as Iraq’s maritime gateway to global markets, reinforced by the recent inauguration of the Khor al-Zubair immersed tunnel to shorten transport distances and connect ports to inland road networks Al-Hasani confirmed that the strategic Development Road project has reached advanced stages in its engineering designs, establishing an overland economic corridor linking the Arabian Gulf to Europe via Iraq and Turkey to diversify national revenue, attract investment partnerships, and generate employment Alongside maritime and rail infrastructure, he noted that the ministry is upgrading air navigation systems, modernizing domestic airports, and expanding Iraqi Airways’ international route network to elevate aviation safety and global connectivity Addressing the conference alongside international partner firms and diplomatic envoys, Turkish Transport Minister Abdulkadir Uraloğlu underscored that disruptions in global supply chains have made diversifying transport routes and enhancing corridor efficiency critical Positioning the Middle East at the crossroads of Asia, Europe, and Africa, Uraloğlu stated that complementing Turkey’s existing East–West transit lines with a North–South axis through Iraq’s Grand Faw Port creates an unprecedented commercial and logistics artery between Asia and Europe Uraloğlu emphasized that the success of the Development Road depends not only on physical rail and highway construction, but also on streamlining border crossings, accelerating customs procedures, and implementing digital transformation across transit networks so borders function as gateways rather than barriers Offering the international expertise of Turkey’s engineering and contracting sectors to support Iraq’s infrastructure rollout, he concluded by noting that European officials contact Ankara every day persistently asking when the Development Road will be completed—a testament, he said, to how recent developments in Europe have validated the corridor’s strategic necessity

selected_news.shorts_hook: Avrupa yetkilileri Irak‑Türkiye yolunun bitiş tarihini soruyor
selected_news.quality_hook: Avrupa yetkilileri Irak‑Türkiye yolunun bitiş tarihini soruyor
selected_news.quality_narration: Irak Ulaştırma Bakanı Wahab Salman Al-Hasani, Irak‑Türkiye Gelişim Yolu projesinin ilerlediğini duyurdu. Türkiye Ulaştırma ve Altyapı Bakanı Abdulkadir Uraloğlu, Avrupa yetkililerinin yolun tamamlanma tarihini her gün sorduğunu belirtti. Projenin mühendislik tasarımları ileri aşamalara ulaşmış ve Körfez’i Avrupa’ya bağlayacak bir koridor oluşturuyor.
